title: CVE-2026-112497
summary: Affected: Apple macOS This issue was addressed with improved permissions checking. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to break out of its sandbox.

title: CVE-2026-112498
summary: Affected: Apple macOS An access issue was addressed with additional sandbox restrictions. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An app may be able to break out of its sandbox.

title: CVE-2026-121222
summary: Affected: Google Chrome Incorrect authorization in Forms in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.38 allowed a remote attacker to bypass web origin policy via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Low)

title: CVE-2026-121217
summary: Affected: Google Chrome Use after free in Streaming in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.38 allowed an adjacent attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via crafted network traffic. (Chromium security severity: Low)

title: CVE-2026-121216
summary: Affected: Google Chrome UI misrepresentation in UI in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.38 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to spoof UI elements via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

title: CVE-2026-121215
summary: Affected: Google Chrome UI misrepresentation in Bluetooth in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.38 allowed a remote attacker to spoof UI elements via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

title: CVE-2026-121213
summary: Affected: Google Chrome Uninitialized resource in Images in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.38 allowed a remote attacker to obtain cross-origin data via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

title: CVE-2026-112501
summary: Affected: Apple iOS and iPadOS, Apple macOS, Apple tvOS, Apple visionOS, Apple watchOS A race condition was addressed with improved state handling. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.7.2 and iPadOS 26.7.2, iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2. An app may be able to cause unexpected system termination.

title: CVE-2026-121212
summary: Affected: Google Chrome Incorrect authorization in Core in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.38 allowed a remote attacker to bypass web origin policy via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Medium)

title: CVE-2026-121211
